tpms.when: R1T 2022–2024 (owner's guide for early-2024 software; no reset step)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the tire placard on the driver's door jamb. If a tire is already warm from driving, add about 4 psi above the placard value, since it will drop as it cools.
There is no reset button or menu: the system reads the new pressures by itself.
Drive above about 18 mph. It can take up to 10 minutes before the driver display shows the tire pressures again.
Check the pressures on the driver display (long-press a steering wheel thumb control to cycle to the tire pressure view). The low pressure warning should clear once all tires read correctly.
tpms.note: If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault that correct pressures will not clear; have Rivian service check it. A compact spare has no sensor, and the system is not designed for aftermarket wheels.

notes: Electric: there is no engine oil to change and no oil reminder to reset. Checked against the R1T owner's guide; the R1S uses the same kind of system but its guide was not checked.
